opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. Motion of respondents Charlie

Broyles and Lisa Kay Colley for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, case consolidated with No. 87-821, Pittston Coal Group et al. v. Sebben et al. [certiorari granted, 484 U. S. 1058], and No. 87-827, McLaughlin, Secretary of Labor, et al. v. Sebben et al. [certiorari granted, 484 U. S. 1058], and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.
